news_items.headline: Talen Energy Q1 EBITDA $473M, Reaffirms 2026 Guidance
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 EBITDA $473M; revenue $1.13B vs $1.05B FactSet estimate; full-year 2026 guidance reaffirmed.

news_items.headline: Talen Energy Q1 2026 Earnings Transcript
news_items.summary: Management emphasized rapid regulatory progress on the pending Cornerstone acquisition and continued data-center buildout at Susquehanna with no slowdown.

news_items.headline: Earnings Flash (TLN) Reports Q1 Revenue $1.13B vs FactSet Est $1.05B
news_items.summary: Q1 revenue $1.13B exceeded FactSet consensus of $1.05B by ~7.6%.

news_items.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Talen Energy price target to $498 from $479, maintains Buy
news_items.summary: Morgan Stanley raised PT to $498 (from $479) and maintained Overweight/Buy rating following Q1 results.

news_items.headline: PJM Base Residual Auction 2027/2028: TLN clears 8,745 MW at $333.44/MW-day
news_items.summary: Talen cleared 8,745 MW in PJM 2027/2028 Base Residual Auction at $333.44/MW-day, equating to roughly $1,067M in capacity revenues for that planning year.

news_items.headline: Talen Energy Announces Pricing of Senior Notes
news_items.summary: Talen Energy priced a senior notes offering; details on size and coupon released this week.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Morgan Stanley raised PT to $498 from $479 this week (maintained Buy/Overweight); aggregate consensus from 15 analysts is Strong Buy (15 Buy / 1 Hold / 0 Sell), avg PT $467.77, range $388.56-$548.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported 2026-05-05 (revenue $1.13B beat, EBITDA $473M, 2026 guide reaffirmed). Next quarterly print is Q2 in early August. Near-term catalysts: pending Cornerstone acquisition close (expected FCF/share uplift via spark spreads + higher forward price marks), continued Susquehanna data-center buildout, and PJM 2027/2028 capacity revenue (~$1.07B at $333.44/MW-day).
